title: Broadcom expands chip deals with Google and Anthropic
title_zh: 博通扩大与谷歌和 Anthropic 的芯片交易
summary: Broadcom deepens AI ties with Google and Anthropic as demand for next-generation compute infrastructure accelerates.
summary_zh: 随着对下一代计算基础设施的需求加速增长，博通加深了与谷歌和 Anthropic 的人工智能联系。

title: Should You Really Buy Stocks Now? Fundstrat's Tom Lee and Billionaire Bill Ackman Offer an Answer That's Crystal Clear.
title_zh: 你现在真的应该购买股票吗？ Fundstrat 的汤姆·李 (Tom Lee) 和亿万富翁比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 给出了非常明确的答案。
summary: Various problems, including the war in Iran, have weighed on appetite for stocks.
summary_zh: 包括伊朗战争在内的各种问题都打压了股市的兴趣。

title: Broadcom’s Google And Anthropic AI Deals Deepen Custom Chip Reliance
title_zh: Broadcom 的 Google 和 Anthropic AI 交易加深了对定制芯片的依赖
summary: Broadcom (NasdaqGS:AVGO) has signed multi-year AI chip and infrastructure agreements with Google and Anthropic. The deals run through 2031 and cover exclusive custom silicon design and supply for next generation AI platforms.
summary_zh: Broadcom（纳斯达克GS：AVGO）已与谷歌和 Anthropic 签署了多年的人工智能芯片和基础设施协议。这些交易持续到 2031 年，涵盖下一代人工智能平台的独家定制芯片设计和供应。

title: Microsoft’s Carbon Deal Tests How AI Growth Meets Environmental Demands
title_zh: 微软的碳交易测试人工智能增长如何满足环境需求
summary: Microsoft has signed its first Canadian bioenergy carbon capture offtake agreement, partnering with Indigenous led consortiums to support carbon removal tied to digital infrastructure.
summary_zh: 微软签署了第一份加拿大生物能源碳捕获承购协议，与原住民领导的财团合作，支持与数字基础设施相关的碳清除。

title: Stock Market Today: Dow Up As Trump Offers This Olive Branch; AI Play Eyes Entry (Live Coverage)
title_zh: 今日股市：特朗普伸出橄榄枝，道指上涨； AI玩眼录入（直播）
summary: The Dow Jones index and Apple rose on the stock market today. President Donald Trump offered an olive branch to Iran even amid more threats.
summary_zh: 道琼斯指数和苹果公司今天股市上涨。尽管面临更多威胁，唐纳德·特朗普总统还是向伊朗伸出了橄榄枝。
